evals.prompt: 次の文章を公開向けの自然な日本語に書き直してください。数値、URL、コード、HTML コメントは変えないでください。入力: 2026年の結果は20件です。詳しくは https://example.test/report を確認してください。`run(20)` <!-- table:cases -->
evals.expected_output: The calling agent routes the complete Markdown through agy rewrite, accepts only a candidate that preserves the number, URL, inline code, and placeholder exactly, then obtains a fresh agy review before handoff.
expectations: Uses the whole-text rewrite path for prose-first Markdown.
Checks that 2026, 20, the URL, inline code, and HTML comment are unchanged.
Uses a fresh agy reviewer and holds the text unless it returns ACCEPT.

evals.prompt: HTML テンプレート中の「送信する」を自然な日本語に直してください。文書にこの文字列が1回だけあります。変更後の HTML を出力し、他のコードは保持してください。
evals.expected_output: The calling agent uses the JSON-pair path, applies the exact unique old/new pair, preserves all protected facts and non-target code, and sends the complete result through a fresh review.
expectations: Uses old/new JSON replacement pairs for Japanese embedded in HTML.
Requires the old string to occur exactly once before applying the pair.
Runs a separate fresh review after applying the replacement.

evals.prompt: 候補文を agy でレビューし、REJECT なら指摘を直して最大2回まで書き直してください。最後に ACCEPT された本文だけを公開対象にしてください。
evals.expected_output: The calling agent follows the bounded reject/rewrite procedure, records only the exact bytes that a fresh agy session accepts, and holds the deliverable if agy is unavailable or the final review rejects it.
expectations: Allows no more than two REJECT-triggered rewrites and performs a final fresh review.
Records the exact accepted text hash only on ACCEPT.
Holds the deliverable on an agy auth, limit, timeout, or other failure.
